description: Mechanical extraction of compiler.ex 5220-5529 plus the ~25 fact-creation sites behind one hidden pure module, BEFORE the ADR-0007 representation migration (which then happens inside the module). Decisions (grilling 2026-10-12): one opaque facts type for scalars and array lengths, under a single v.facts key (six loose keys collapse; no stray v[:lo] possible). Interface: assert + per-op derivations (add/sub/mul/div/minmax/bit/bsr) in; prove_in_bounds/prove_i64/lo/hi out, prove_in_bounds returns its support (the bindings the proof used - ADR-0007 needs it visible to the flagged-strip classifier); missing/3 absorbs the report's perturbation loop (compiler.ex 6311-6332); carries?/covers?/weaken serve the accumulator carry, whose backtracking protocol and fin stay in the compiler (fin is a contents fact, out of scope). New facts_test.exs property suite as the module's spec (random values satisfying asserted facts => proven queries hold); scaled_facts_test.exs kept as the e2e truth net for the assert sites. Gate: dump-all-C byte-identical. CONTEXT.md 'Range fact' added.
